test_cases.description: Log in successfully with a valid username and password.
test_cases.expected_result: The user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.

test_cases.description: Attempt to log in with an unregistered or invalid username.
test_steps: Enter an unregistered or invalid username.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied and an appropriate invalid-username error message is displayed.

test_cases.description: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied and an appropriate invalid-password error message is displayed.

test_cases.description: Attempt to log in with both username and password fields empty.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied and validation messages indicate that credentials are required.

test_cases.description: Attempt to log in with only the username empty.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied and a username-required validation message is displayed.

test_cases.description: Attempt to log in with only the password empty.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied and a password-required validation message is displayed.

test_cases.description: Attempt to log in as a locked-out user with otherwise valid credentials.
test_steps: Enter the username of a locked-out account.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied and a locked-account or account-suspended message is displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify that whitespace-only credential fields are not accepted.
test_steps: Enter only spaces in the username field.
Enter only spaces in the password field.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied and appropriate required-field or invalid-credentials messages are shown.

test_cases.description: Attempt to log in with both username and password invalid.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied and a secure generic authentication error is displayed without revealing whether the username or password was invalid.

test_cases.description: Verify credentials are handled safely after a failed login attempt.
test_steps: Enter a registered username and incorrect password.
test_cases.expected_result: The corrected credentials authenticate successfully, and the user is redirected to the dashboard.

test_cases.description: Verify that navigating back after a successful login does not expose the login session improperly.
test_steps: Use the browser Back button to return to the login page.
test_cases.expected_result: The application does not present an exposed unauthenticated login state; the user is redirected appropriately or the login page remains secure according to session policy.
